title: Great placemats, gives your table the great holiday feel!
text: Great placemats, gives your table the great holiday feel!. These are the cutest placemats ever for the holidays. I have a small round table off of my kitchen that has 4 chairs and it's amazing how festive these mats made that area look! Colorful, well made and I love the red and white colors. The plaid is great too and just adds to the holiday feeling. Highly recommend for all homes to add to your holiday decorations!
